visualCharacteristics.purpose: Feature row pairing a product UI image with a heading, paragraph and bold-lead bullet list
visualCharacteristics.description: Two columns on white: product UI image and H3/paragraph/bold-lead bullet list, sides alternate

contentPattern.structure: one row, two cells: a media cell (image, optionally followed by a paragraph holding a link to an .mp4 file for an ambient video) and a text cell (H3, paragraph, bulleted list with <strong> lead-ins). Cell order sets which side the media is on; on mobile the media always stacks first

cells: H3 + paragraph + bulleted list (each item: <strong> lead-in + text)
rows.note: Cell order follows the source: image first in sections 3, 5 and 7; text first in sections 4 and 6.

usage.description: Use for alternating image/text feature sections; alternate sides by swapping cell order.

reuseGuidance: Reuse for any image + rich text two-column feature; do not use for promo bands (columns-promo).
